private_evidence_registry.portability_note: BCS-000068 is a curated verbatim ChatGPT excerpt snapshot with exact UTC timestamps; stable native message IDs are unavailable through the current connector.
private_evidence_registry.public_sync: Do not copy private conversation excerpts/evidence into public dnd-solo without explicit review.

corpus_invariant.text: bfdm-corpus is not primarily a training dataset. It is the durable research archive of Brendon's D&D creative history. Kit is one consumer of it.
corpus_invariant.operational_rule: Archive integrity and long-term research value outrank convenience for any current Kit implementation; model-facing datasets are downstream derivatives.

work_gpt_ingestion_contract.branch_rule: If PR #5 is unmerged, base ingest/drive-project-v1 on research/organize-current-work-v1; otherwise base on current main.
work_gpt_ingestion_contract.scope_rule: Archive source history first; no BCE/personality/training synthesis during ingestion.

machine_registry.identity_note: S3 Discord identity is account-ID confirmed. Empire City / Season 4 is now server-linked, but Brendon's account mapping in that server remains unresolved until its users table is inspected.
machine_registry.chronology_note: Human-readable chronology remains research narrative; machine registry stores structured dates/format/scale/coverage with explicit uncertainty.
